notes: Source: Packers 2026 media guide, section RECORDS & CHAMPIONSHIPS: 'Packers Individual Records' (printed pp. 315-330 = pdf pp. 317-332; pdf page = printed page + 2), every page headed 'Regular-Season Games Only'; career passing/rushing/receiving tables on printed p. 368 (pdf p. 370). Postseason records (printed p. 502), opponent records (printed p. 332) and team records were not used.
through_season 2025: the lists include 2025 entries (Josh Jacobs 2025 rushing TDs, Rashan Gary 2019-25 sacks, Quay Walker 2022-25 as team tackle leader, Jordan Love 2021-25 passing).

Format: the guide prints no rank numbers in the Individual Records section; a value is printed once and every name tied at that value follows on its own line (names under a shared value are ties). Ranks here are competition ranks by position (1,2,2,4...); tie=true on every member of a tied group; for such continuation rows raw shows the group value in square brackets, e.g. '[480] Aaron Rodgers, ...'. A leading * means 'holds or shares NFL record' (kept only in raw). Game rows: `years` = date (m/d/yyyy, converted from 'Dec. 28, 2003') + 'vs./at opponent' as printed; the printed '(n att.)', '(n comp.)', '(n yds.)', '(n rec.)', '(n games)', '(n seasons)' tails stay in raw only.

Method: every digit was read from 200-400 dpi crops of the page pictures (the IA OCR misreads several values, e.g. 1,307 as 4,307, 1,253 as 4,253, 169 as 469). The p370 tables were also checked arithmetically (completion % = Cmp/Att, yards per carry or reception = Yds/No) and agree with the printed percentages and averages for every transcribed row.

Inconsistency inside the guide: the Most Receptions, Career list (pdf p325) ends at James Lofton 530, but the p370 receptions table ranks Randall Cobb (532) 5th and Lofton 6th; Lofton's row on p325 is flagged uncertain for that reason. All other top-5 career values (pass yards, pass TDs, rush yards, rec yards) are identical on pdf p370 and on the Individual Records pages.

Sacks: official NFL statistic since 1982; the lists are headed '(1982-2025)' and no unofficial pre-1982 list is printed, only the footnotes about Ezra Johnson (20.5 unofficial sacks in 1978; 5 in the 9/3/78 game) and Dave Pureifory (5 sacks at LARm, 12/14/75). Tackles: coaches' counts 1975-2019, league-provided counts from 2020, per the guide's footnote.

Not transcribed (stated in each scope_note): tie groups below the leaders in game lists (receptions 11-group, receiving TDs 3-group, sacks 3.0 group), the one-line count entries ('4  58 times', '3  Several times', '10  34 times'), the interceptions-by-rookie and other rookie-only lists, unassisted (solo) tackle lists, and extended p370 rows beyond rank 10.
